journey.name: NewsVista App Journey
journey.description: A journey instruction to test the NewsVista App

actions.action: Verify the app at least shows a top bar containing in this order: A hamburger icon aligned to the top left, the text "NewsVista" to the right of the icon, and a search icon aligned to the right of the screen
Verify the app to show at least some news headlines under the top bar, each headline could contain a picture and a text.
